Since I also figured a lot of new stuff was needed to account for the inclusion of the original tutorial for the PC version, that was another problem I had to figure out. I had to write and debug in lots of new code to ensure that the campaign could go forward without the computer players blocking each other’s movements, as well as a new player movement code (a modified version of the one I had used for The Death of Venus).
